nodes.label: In-Process node:sqlite WAL Persistence Engine
nodes.rationale: Uses synchronous ACID transactions in WAL mode to persist orders, trades, positions, accounts, candles, and audit_logs.

nodes.label: Argus Terminal Institutional System
nodes.rationale: Zero-build-step local-first institutional trading & market analytics terminal combining L2 matching, GBM market simulation, node:sqlite WAL persistence, and high-DPI Canvas 2D charts.

nodes.label: Bloomberg <GO> Command Bar & Dialog Palette
nodes.rationale: Keyboard-driven institutional command router supporting instrument switching, chart modes, and DMA execution shortcuts.

nodes.label: Light-Dismiss <dialog> Command Palette Modal
nodes.rationale: Native HTML5 <dialog closedby='any'> modal with JS backdrop coordinate fallback for instant <GO> command execution.

nodes.label: Direct Market Access (DMA) Order Entry Ticket
nodes.norm_label: direct market access (dma) order entry ticket
nodes.rationale: Interactive institutional order entry form supporting LIMIT/MARKET execution, notional preview, and quick-fill size multipliers.

nodes.label: Price-Time Priority (FIFO) L2 Matching Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Deterministic strict price-time priority queue sorting bids descending and asks ascending, breaking ties by timestamp and monotonic sequence ID.

nodes.label: Mean-Reverting Geometric Brownian Motion Simulator
nodes.rationale: Couples discrete-time Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean reversion around base_price with Poisson-like liquidity replenishment and 400ms tick cadence.

nodes.label: VULN-05: Missing 5x Pre-Trade Buying Power & 64KB Cap (CVSS 8.0)
nodes.norm_label: vuln-05: missing 5x pre-trade buying power & 64kb cap (cvss 8.0)
nodes.rationale: Enforced 5x cash_balance notional buying power gate in Orderbook.submitOrder and 64KB JSON body cap in readJsonBody.

nodes.label: SEC Rule 15c3-5 Pre-Trade Market Access Risk Gate
nodes.norm_label: sec rule 15c3-5 pre-trade market access risk gate
nodes.rationale: Prevents unbacked fat-finger institutional orders from crossing the matching engine without synchronous credit and leverage verification.

nodes.label: High-DPI Canvas 2D OHLCV & L2 Market Depth Engine
nodes.norm_label: high-dpi canvas 2d ohlcv & l2 market depth engine
nodes.rationale: DevicePixelRatio-scaled Canvas 2D renderer supporting CANDLES, DEPTH, and SPLIT views with EMA(9/21) and session VWAP overlays.

nodes.label: Multi-Pane Institutional Tiling Grid Workspace
nodes.rationale: CSS Grid & Container Query responsive 4-zone institutional workspace housing Watchlist, Center Chart, L2 Ladder/DMA Ticket, and Blotter.

nodes.label: VULN-01: SQL Injection in Order Search (CVSS 9.8)
nodes.norm_label: vuln-01: sql injection in order search (cvss 9.8)
nodes.rationale: Remediated string interpolation in GET /api/orders/search by binding parameterized LIKE wildcards.

nodes.label: VULN-02: Unrestricted SQL Console & Secret Exposure (CVSS 9.6)
nodes.norm_label: vuln-02: unrestricted sql console & secret exposure (cvss 9.6)
nodes.rationale: Enforced single-statement SELECT-only allowlist, comment rejection, and accounts/api_secret table blocklist in validateReadOnlySql.

nodes.label: VULN-03: Webhook Test SSRF to Loopback/Metadata (CVSS 8.6)
nodes.norm_label: vuln-03: webhook test ssrf to loopback/metadata (cvss 8.6)
nodes.rationale: Blocked loopback, RFC 1918 private IPv4/IPv6, link-local 169.254.169.254 metadata, and .local/.internal domains in validateWebhookTargetUrl.

nodes.label: VULN-04: Broken Access Control on RESTRICTED Tier (CVSS 8.2)
nodes.norm_label: vuln-04: broken access control on restricted tier (cvss 8.2)
nodes.rationale: Enforced X-API-Key header verification against accounts.api_secret for RESTRICTED tier accounts (ACC-VAULT-99) in verifyAccountAccess.

nodes.label: WS Event: CANDLE & NEWS Wire Broadcast
nodes.norm_label: ws event: candle & news wire broadcast
nodes.rationale: Broadcasts 1-minute OHLCV bar updates and breaking institutional macro headlines.

nodes.label: WS Event: ORDERBOOK & TRADE Broadcast
nodes.rationale: Streams 15-level aggregated L2 orderbook snapshots and real-time maker/taker execution fills.

nodes.label: WS Event: SNAPSHOT & TICK Stream
nodes.rationale: Hydrates initial client state on connection and streams 400ms multi-asset valuation ticks.

nodes.label: WebSocket Real-Time Market Multiplexer (/ws)
nodes.rationale: Multiplexes SNAPSHOT, TICK, ORDERBOOK, TRADE, CANDLE, NEWS, and PORTFOLIO_UPDATE frames with symbol-filtered subscriptions.
